response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL equipstatus are excluded, because `<>` does not match NULL. Keeping them would require an explicit NULL check.
Observatories with a NULL lunarstage form their own group and are kept in the results. AVG skips NULL bandusagepct values, as the request asks.
Ties in telescope_count have no specified order, so the top 10 may vary among tied rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat telescopes with no equipment status as not in 'Maintenance' and keep them in the results.
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus IS NULL OR t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
